title: Govee's smart nugget ice maker makes every iced drink feel like a luxury | TechCrunch
summary: The ice maker also supports voice commands with Alexa and Google Assistant, which means a quick ““Hey Google, start the ice maker,” leads to fresh ice. The ice maker uses what Govee calls AI NoiseGuard technology to keep operating noise low, too.
